messages:
ben_sales: Passing Clinica Health to CS + Support for onboarding & private deploy prep. Deal: $220k ARR, Dedicated reserved capacity, Private VPC, 24mo term. PO attached. Kickoff target 2028-05-10.

ben_sales: Primary customer asks: HIPAA/BAA, customer-managed KMS, Okta SSO, future EHR connector (PHI sync), EU+us-east data residency, and p95 latency goal <140ms. Procurement wants 60-day SLA guardrails.

maria_cs: Thanks — can you drop the PO link and tech contact here? Also any signed BAAs?

ben_sales: PO: https://drive.redwood.com/clinica_signed_po.pdf. Contacts: sara@clinica.health (tech lead), marco@clinica.health (procurement). Okta tenant: clinica-prod-okta. BAA pending legal review (looping them).

olivia_onboard: Onboarding questions: will they ingest raw PHI or tokenized payloads? expected throughput patterns? batch export cadence?

ben_sales: They will send raw notes (PHI) for triage + embeddings for search. Expected steady ~300 rps, pilot bursts to ~800 rps for ~7 days. Monthly analytics export ~100GB.

nate_support: Opening support ticket CS-2456 to track network/VPC peering, firewall rules, and private-deploy checklist. Initial note: need customer ASN, CIDR suggestion, and VPN endpoints.

kevin_eng: From infra: need staging creds + anonymized sample set to validate quality after quantization. Perf plan: perf-run --model clinical-v2 --n 2000 --concurrency 16. If p95 > 140ms, test gRPC batching and INT8 quant. Will post numbers here.

maria_cs: Renewal risk: HIGH until 60-day window closes. Procurement asked for credits if error-rate >1.5% first 60 days. Track metrics: error-rate, p95 latency, token cost per route.

olivia_onboard: Proposed owners: maria_cs (CS lead), olivia_onboard (onboarding lead), nate_support (support triage), kevin_eng (eng/perf & private deploy), ben_sales (sales escalation). I'll create onboarding runbook and calendar invite.

maria_cs: Action items recap: 1) Olivia schedule kickoff by 2028-05-05; 2) Nate attach network logs & open CS-2456 (in progress); 3) Kevin run perf once staging ready; 4) Olivia obtain anonymized sample + ingestion playbook; 5) CS to set 7/30/90 health check cadence + weekly status emails for first 8 weeks.

nate_support: CS-2456 created: https://support.redwood.com/cs-2456 1 attached initial traceroute (shows intermittent packet loss). Requesting updated VPN configs and firewall egress rules from customer.

jira-bot: CS-2456 transitioned to "In Progress" by nate_support.

ben_sales: Procurement also requested a per-route cost breakdown and monthly usage forecast. I'll share the pricing workbook.

kevin_eng: Need KMS key setup details; security wants a KMS ticket for customer-managed keys. Also will need access to a staging bucket for monthly export tests. Security docs: https://security.redwood.com/kms-guide.

olivia_onboard: Kickoff scheduled: 2028-05-10 09:00 PT. Invite sent to Sara, Marco, security, infra, legal. Agenda: demo, sample data transfer, VPC peering steps, initial perf expectations. I'll ask for anonymized PHI sample and ingestion playbook during the call.

maria_cs: I'll draft the CS playbook in Confluence and share link here (draft). Setting renewal alerts at 180/90/60/30 days given long term; Renewal owner: ben_sales.

nate_support: Ping @oncall-network for peering and routing verification. Note: we likely need a NAT change for the peered subnet.

olivia_onboard: I'll own the weekly status email + dashboard snapshot (latency, error rate, token usage). Will post template here after kickoff.

maria_cs: Risk tags: high-latency-risk, PHI-data, renewal-sensitive. I'll open a 30-day checkpoint thread after launch to capture metrics & any escalations.

kevin_eng: Once staging creds are in, running perf today/tomorrow. Will post raw numbers + tuned results (batching/quant).

ben_sales: Looping legal for BAA and SOC report. Also customer asked for single-tenant log separation and audit controls.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Next sync after kickoff to verify CS-2456 resolved and perf numbers posted. We'll keep renewal as high-risk until metrics stabilize.
